interfaces: Observed binary branch computes -ln(p) or -ln_1p(-p); never 0*ln(0).
Per-label losses count N label decisions; means count N*K; signals use selected IDs and reference positivity.
No multi-label argmax, confidence, ECE, or joint set probability is synthesized.
acceptance_criteria: [0.8,0.7] with reference {A} yields mean Brier .265 and (-ln(.8)-ln(.3))/2, including on abstention.
Zero-probability observed outcomes yield explicit infinity; empty absent labels with zero marginals yield zero loss.
One-label binary Brier .04 differs from two-class categorical .08; bins at 0/.1/1 follow presence, not correctness.
Check/evaluate/inspect/replay accept both concrete tasks without duplicate I/O logic.
Actual multi-label check/report/inspection documents validate against strict published schema alternatives.
